text: Geological resources and engineering is an interdisciplinary subject centered on the exploration and development of earth resources as well as the construction of geological projects. It integrates geological theories with engineering technologies, focusing on "how to scientifically obtain earth resources" and "how to solve geological problems in engineering construction". From the extraction of oil and coal, to the foundation stabilization of bridges and tunnels, and to the prevention and control of geological disasters, all of these processes rely on the technical support of this discipline.
